race.comment: SAVVY SPY (8) is a stayer on the ascendancy. Made it a hat trick last Saturday when he came from just off the speed and was too strong in a BM78 over 2400m at Rosehill. Needs to go to another level here but on the limit on a seven-day back-up he makes plenty of appeal. Stablemate CAMPALDINO (1) has been uncharacteristically poor this prep, albeit largely in better races than this. Like the fact that Gai and Adrian are persevering so he might still have something left to offer. DON DIEGO DE VEGA (6) was a bit flat second-up last start after an excellent return two back in the Port Macquarie Cup. Expect a far better performance today. DOCTOR ASKAR (3) is another who can lift at the third run of the campaign following a couple of plain efforts.
